result:
I’ll inspect how spans store and load their data, then add copy and pickle support with focused tests. I’ll use the repository’s Python style skill.

The failures come from OpenTelemetry’s internal locks and lazy loading being triggered by Python’s copy machinery. I’ll serialize spans through their existing data representation, preserve attachments separately, and restore lazy spans without loading them. Live spans will raise an error directing callers to `to_immutable_span()`.

The span and trace tests completed without test failures, including the new copy and pickle cases. Pytest then hit a sandbox permission error in the repository’s final process-cleanup hook. I’m checking the diff and adding an explicit assertion that lazy-span pickles omit the duplicate raw JSON.

Implemented copy and pickle support for immutable spans, lazy spans, no-op spans, and whole traces, preserving attachments while avoiding internal locks.

Lazy spans restore unloaded without duplicate raw JSON. Shallow copies retain shared internals. Live spans reject deep copy and pickle with guidance to call `to_immutable_span()`.

Added regression tests: 20 focused tests passed. Broader span/trace tests had no test failures, but their final reporting hook encountered a sandbox permission error.

+    def __copy__(self):
+        span = type(self).__new__(type(self))
+        span.__dict__.update(self.__dict__)

 )
 
+from tests.tracing.helper import create_test_trace_info
+
+
+def _pickle_round_trip(value):
+    return pickle.loads(pickle.dumps(value))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("restore", [copy.deepcopy, _pickle_round_trip])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("span_kind", ["immutable", "lazy", "materialized_lazy"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("whole_trace", [False, True])
+def test_span_copy_and_pickle(restore, span_kind, whole_trace):
+    tracer = _get_tracer("test")
+    with tracer.start_as_current_span("parent") as otel_span:
+        live = LiveSpan(otel_span, trace_id="tr-12345", span_type=SpanType.LLM)
+        live.set_inputs({"input": [1, 2]})
+        live.set_outputs({"output": 3})
+        live.set_status("OK")
+        live.add_event(SpanEvent("event", timestamp=123, attributes={"key": "value"}))
+    span = live.to_immutable_span()
+    expected = span.to_dict()
+    if span_kind != "immutable":
+        span = LazySpan.from_stored_content(json.dumps(expected))
+        if span_kind == "materialized_lazy":
+            assert span.name == "parent"
+    attachment = Attachment(content_type="text/plain", content_bytes=b"attachment content")
+    span._attachments = {attachment.id: attachment}
+    if span_kind != "immutable":
+        assert span.__dict__["_raw_json"].encode() not in pickle.dumps(span)
+    original = Trace(info=create_test_trace_info("tr-12345"), data=TraceData([span]))
+
+    restored = restore(original if whole_trace else span)
+    if whole_trace:
+        assert restored.info == original.info
+        restored = restored.data.spans[0]
+    assert restored is not span
+    assert type(restored) is type(span)
+    if span_kind != "immutable":
+        assert restored.__dict__["_materialized"] is False
+        assert restored.__dict__["_raw_json"] is None
+        assert "_span" not in restored.__dict__
+        assert span.__dict__["_raw_json"] is not None
+        assert span.__dict__["_materialized"] == (span_kind == "materialized_lazy")
+    assert restored.to_dict() == expected
+    assert restored.inputs == {"input": [1, 2]}
+    assert restored.outputs == {"output": 3}
+    assert restored.events == span.events
+    restored_attachment = restored._attachments[attachment.id]
+    assert restored_attachment is not attachment
+    assert restored_attachment.id == attachment.id
+    assert restored_attachment.content_type == attachment.content_type
+    assert restored_attachment.content_bytes == attachment.content_bytes
+    restored.inputs["input"].append(4)
+    assert span.inputs == {"input": [1, 2]}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("restore", [copy.deepcopy, _pickle_round_trip])
+def test_live_span_rejects_copy_and_pickle(restore):
+    with _get_tracer("test").start_as_current_span("parent") as otel_span:
+        span = LiveSpan(otel_span, trace_id="tr-12345")
+        with pytest.raises(TypeError, match=r"to_immutable_span\(\)"):
+            restore(span)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("live", [False, True])
+def test_span_shallow_copy(live):
+    with _get_tracer("test").start_as_current_span("parent") as otel_span:
+        span = LiveSpan(otel_span, trace_id="tr-12345")
+        if not live:
+            span = span.to_immutable_span()
+        copied = copy.copy(span)
+        assert copied is not span
+        assert type(copied) is type(span)
+        assert copied._span is span._span
+        assert copied.inputs == span.inputs
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("restore", [copy.copy, copy.deepcopy, _pickle_round_trip])
+def test_noop_span_copy_and_pickle(restore):
+    span = NoOpSpan()
+    restored = restore(span)
+    assert isinstance(restored, NoOpSpan)
+    assert restored is not span
+    assert restored.trace_id == span.trace_id
+    assert restored.name is None
+    restored.set_inputs({"input": 1})
+    assert restored.inputs is None
+

     trace_id = "tr-12345"

+def _sse(event):

+def _tool_use_stream(blocks):
+    """blocks: list of ("text", str) or ("tool", id, name, partial_json)."""
+    events = [

+        else:
+            start = {"type": "tool_use", "id": block[1], "name": block[2], "input": {}}
+            delta = {"type": "input_json_delta", "partial_json": block[3]}
+        events += [
+            {"type": "content_block_start", "index": i, "content_block": start},
